verdict.rationale: Viam has a CLI that can call any API method with JSON in/out, supports SQL queries and data export headlessly, and documents an explicit 'use Viam from an agent' pathway where a shell or SDK can drive machines non-interactively — strong signals for CI/headless automation. However, there is no dedicated CI integration guide, no mention of Docker/container-based CI runners, no GitHub Actions examples, and no evidence of automated test/deploy pipelines beyond manual CLI invocation. missing for 10: CI-specific documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions/pipeline examples), containerized/headless deployment guides, independent hands-on confirmation of CI usage.
